name: Jether
overview: Jether was a male member of the tribe of Judah, known primarily as the son of Ezrah. His mention in Scripture is brief and does not include additional personal details or notable events. As a descendant within Judah, he contributes to the genealogical records important for understanding the lineage of God's people.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Jether' appears as a proper name in Scripture without a given meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply recorded as his personal name in 1 Chronicles 4:17.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Jether as the son of Ezrah, establishing his immediate paternal relationship. Beyond this, no further family connections are recorded for him.
scriptureSignificance: Jether's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah, which underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving His people through generations. Although no specific deeds or roles are attributed to him, his mention affirms the continuity of God's covenant community as documented in 1 Chronicles.
